svg.aria-label: Breadboard diagram: ESP8266 straddling the centre gap with USB to the right and the OLED on the left. Two push buttons sit across the gap on the right, wired to D7 and D6 with a shared ground. A buzzer above them is wired to D8 and GND. A potentiometer below the breadboard is wired to 3V3, A0 and GND.
svg.title: OLED clock breadboard wiring
